_comment: STATIC PINNED DNSSEC trust anchors for the two private test islands used by
this PoC (supplied out-of-band by AFNIC). These zones do NOT chain to the
public DNS root, so validation is anchored here.
*** PIN IS STATIC — RFC 5011 (automated trust-anchor rollover) is OUT OF SCOPE. ***
The observer is a run-once CLI: it cannot maintain RFC 5011 state (30-day
add-hold-down, continuous DNSKEY polling, REVOKE tracking). If AFNIC rolls a
KSK, re-pin the new DNSKEY here by hand. In a real deployment, anchor
lifecycle belongs to a persistent validator (unbound/BIND auto-trust-anchor).
Data only: DNSKEY records are public. Alg 13 = ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256.
Consumed by identity_lookup.py; nothing else in the pipeline reads this.

anchors.use: DET -> PTR reverse chain (Apex -> RAA -> HDA -> DET/PTR)
